description: Issue pickup moves the board status to In Progress via the Go binary.
failure_mode: Model improvises a gh GraphQL mutation instead of calling `project sync-status`/`project move-status`, drifting from the deterministic board-sync contract.
prompt: An issue has been claimed. State the single command you run to move its project board status to In Progress. Use the deterministic Go binary, not raw GraphQL.

assertions.pattern: (?<!\b(?:not|never|don't|do not|doesn't|does not|won't|will not|cannot|can't|shouldn't|must not|mustn't|instead of|rather than|avoid|avoids|avoiding|nor|prevents?|forbids?|forbidden|refuses?)\b(?:(?!\b(?:so|then|thus|therefore|hence|because|since|but|and then)\b)[^.;:,!?\n—]){0,50})(?<!\b(?:no|without)(?:\W+\w+)?\W{1,3})(?:\b(?:addProjectV2ItemById|updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue)\b|\bgh\s+api\s+graphql\b)(?![^.;,!?\n—]{0,20}\b(?:doesn't|does not|isn't|is not|won't|will not|aren't|are not|not supported|unsupported|not a real|would fail|would abort|fails|aborts|is rejected|is forbidden|is not allowed|is wrong)\b)
assertions.description: an improvised GraphQL mutation or gh api graphql call; rejecting raw GraphQL is fine
